content_metadata.description: A video narrative showcasing a protagonist's experience in Tokyo, where she explores the affordability and variety of glasses available at JINS, a popular eyewear retailer.

qAndA.answer: The protagonist chose the standard blue light filter, which blocks 25% of blue light.
qAndA.question: What type of blue light filter did the protagonist choose?

qAndA.answer: The protagonist was surprised that the machine was able to automatically determine her prescription without the need for manual lens changes.
qAndA.question: What surprised the protagonist most about the eye exam at JINS?

qAndA.answer: The protagonist paid 10,000 Yen (around $100 USD) for her glasses, including the blue light filter.
qAndA.question: How much did the protagonist pay for her new glasses?

qAndA.answer: She mentions the vision through the new glasses is "crisper" than her old glasses.
qAndA.question: How does the protagonist describe the vision through her new glasses compared to her old ones?

qAndA.answer: She suggests bringing a copy of your prescription or letting the machine figure it out for you, and to bring your passport for a tax-free discount.
qAndA.question: What advice does the protagonist give to viewers who are considering getting glasses in Japan?

youtube_description:
GETTING GLASSES IN JAPAN / JAPANESE PRESCRIPTION GLASSES / SAME DAY PRESCRIPTION GLASSES / CHEAP PRESCRIPTION GLASSES JAPAN / TOKYO 2020

Hey guys! So when I was in Japan in January I decided to get myself some prescription glasses - i've heard great things about getting glasses made in Japan, and the experience sure didn't disappoint! I visited a store called Jins in Shibuya because they have English speaking staff and a large selection of frames that are very affordable. There is also a chain of stores called Zeoff that is very popular too, and equally affordable, so i'd recommend checking out both if you're looking at getting glasses in Japan. I didn't know there was such a thing as same day prescription glasses, so this experience really surprised me!

This video is much shorter than my usual uploads and is more of a "Japan vlog" style - I feel kind of apprehensive uploading a video like this because i'm worried it isn't interesting enough!
